display_long_description:
Take Flight and Dodge the Flock in the Ultimate VR Reflex Challenge!

Spread your wings and prepare for a high-speed airborne adventure in Feather Dodge! In this vibrant, fast-paced VR arcade experience, you control a swift little bird soaring through a dense, beautiful pine forest. Your mission is simple but intense: survive the incoming rush of eccentric, colorful birds flying straight your way!

The sky gets crowded quickly as a massive variety of round, stylized feathered rivals zoom past. Use your VR controllers to seamlessly weave left, right, up, and down to avoid sudden mid-air collisions. As the timer ticks up, the speed increases and the patterns become trickier, pushing your hand-eye coordination and spatial awareness to the absolute limit.

How long can you rule the forest canopy before the chaos catches up to you?

Key Features:
Intuitive VR Controls: Seamlessly guide your bird's flight path using your VR controllers for sharp, precise, and responsive dodging mechanics.

Fast-Paced Arcade Thrills: Experience a continuous wave of unpredictable incoming traffic that tests your reaction speed with every second.

Vibrant Stylized Visuals: Fly through a beautifully animated 3D forest environment filled with lush greenery, towering trees, and a colorful cast of expressive avian characters.

Dynamic High-Score Tracking: Watch your survival time climb in real-time, push past your limits, and try to break your personal record on every run.
